mapper.insert: insert into api (project_id, api_name, request_url, request_method, create_time, create_user, status, explanation, in_charge_user) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{apiName}, #{requestUrl}, #{requestMethod}, now(), #{createUser}, #{status}, #{explanation}, #{inChargeUser})
mapper.update:
update api
api_name = #{apiName},
status=#{status},
explanation=#{explanation},
in_charge_user=#{inChargeUser},
where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select a.id, project_id, api_name, request_url, request_method, create_time, status, explanation, in_charge_user, u.name as create_user from api a left join user u on a.create_user = u.id where project_id=#{id} order by status desc
